svg.title: Prudently — Security Architecture
svg.desc: Defense-in-depth security controls across the Prudently hospital-operations agent fleet: perimeter, authentication, authorization, agent-fleet controls, data protection, and identity/IAM, plus the audit trail that spans all of them.
svg.text: Defense-in-depth, layer by layer — perimeter through data protection to identity.
PERIMETER — first thing an anonymous request touches
no request is trusted by default
cap is a cost ceiling, not a throttle
role custom claim set by admin script
AUTHORIZATION — what a verified caller may see
AGENT FLEET CONTROLS — every internal and external agent call
DATA PROTECTION — patient PII, once real data exists
not a self-declared caller on shared IAM
Every deployed agent runs as its
no shared identity holds app grants
narrower than the general secrets set
make lint / make test on every PR
Every layer above is live and independently verifiable — real GCP identities, real encryption keys, real audit records, not diagram conventions.
Real Google Cloud security products in this diagram: Cloud KMS · Secret Manager · IAM · Firebase Authentication · Model Armor · Cloud Trace/Logging · Cloud Run (managed TLS).
